description: pebble_beds::stochastic_media RSA (pack_spheres) jams above ~0.31 in a finite box (below the 0.38 asymptote). Pebble-bed-realistic ~0.6 packing needs close random packing (Jodrey-Tory, mirror OpenMC _close_random_pack openmc/model/triso.py:921) and/or the Tan et al. RSA-DEM/ODR-DEM methods (PackingMethod::RsaDem/OdrDem currently return NotImplemented). References already in pebble_beds::references.
